name: Qiyana
title: Empress of the Elements

Q.name: Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal
Q.description: If Qiyana does not have an Enchantment, she slashes, dealing 70/100/130/160/190 + 0.9×bonus AD physical damage to enemies in a small area. If she does, this Ability gains extra range and an additional effect based on the type of Enchantment:Ice Enchantment: Briefly Roots, then Slows by 20% for 1 second.Rock Enchantment: Deals an additional (70/100/130/160/190 + 0.9×bonus AD) × 0.6+ (by level) physical damage to units below 50% Health.Wild Enchantment: Leaves a trail that turns Qiyana Invisible and grants 20% Move Speed.
Q.summary: Qiyana swings her weapon, dealing damage with a bonus effect based on her element.

W.name: Terrashape
W.description: Passive: While Qiyana's weapon is Enchanted, she gains 15/20/25/30/35% Attack Speed and her Attacks deal an additional 8/16/24/32/40 + 0.45×AP + 0.2×bonus AD magic damage. She also gains 3/5/7.0/9/11% Move Speed while out of combat near the corresponding terrain type. Active: Qiyana dashes towards a nearby brush, terrain, or river and Enchants her weapon with that particular terrain type. This refreshes Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal's Cooldown.
W.summary: Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element. Her attacks and abilities deal bonus damage while her weapon is enchanted.

E.name: Audacity
E.description: Qiyana dashes through an enemy and deals 50/90/130/170/210 + 0.5×bonus AD physical damage to them.
E.summary: Qiyana dashes to an enemy, damaging them.

R.name: Supreme Display of Talent
R.description: Qiyana launches a shockwave that Knocks Back enemies and detonates when it hits terrain. The explosion follows the entire edge of the terrain, Stunning for between 0.5 and 1 seconds and dealing 100/200/300 + 1.25×bonus AD plus 0.1 max Health physical damage. Stun duration scales down with distance the shockwave has travelled. Any river or brush the shockwave passes through also explode after a delay for the same damage and Stun.
R.summary: Qiyana sends out a shockwave that detonates whatever elements she hits with it, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.

Passive.name: Royal Privilege
Passive.description: Qiyana's first basic attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.
Passive.summary: Qiyana's first basic attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: AD assassin who enchants her weapon by dashing to river, terrain or brush, changing what her Q does. Wins with burst combos and an R shockwave that stuns along walls in teamfights.
strengths: Q enchantments: ice roots then slows, rock deals bonus damage to low-health targets, grass gives camouflage
R knocks back and stuns everyone along the wall it hits: game-changing near terrain
Two dashes (W toward terrain, E through an enemy)
Royal Privilege passive: bonus damage on the first hit against each enemy
weaknesses: R needs walls near enemies; weak in open areas
Squishy and commits with her dashes

curve.lvl3: strong – W enchant + E + Q full burst
curve.items: strong – first lethality item (Profane Hydra, Youmuu's or Opportunity)
curve.late: medium – one teamfight R near terrain, otherwise a pick assassin

profile.curveNote: Needs W enchant + E + Q for her combo.

Passive.notes: First attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.

Q.notes: Slash; enchanted versions: ice briefly roots then slows, rock bonus damage to low-health, grass camouflage.

W.notes: Dash toward terrain/brush/river; enchants her weapon and resets Q.

E.notes: Dash through an enemy, damaging them.

R.notes: Shockwave knocks back; when it hits terrain, the edge explodes and stuns (shorter with distance).

profile.windowAgainst: Fight in open areas away from walls; punish her after both dashes are spent.
